title: Three Vans, a Startled Farmer and an Iranian Plot Against the U.S.

sentences.en: 33 presidents.
sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.en: I called the president at 4.30 in the morning and he answered.
sentences.zh: 我凌晨4点半给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 太空探索七十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗恒星之外有什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费品指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60份超级圣代。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联盟里最强的球队。

sentences.en: 53,500 puzzles.
I use a different starting word every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都用不同的起始词。

And I love a one-pan recipe because I don't love washing pans.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢一锅出的食谱，因为我不喜欢洗锅。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》，庆祝175年来致力于帮助您了解世界并充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 现在订阅可享受优惠，请访问 nytimes.com/subscribe。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今日要闻。

sentences.en: The mysterious story of what exactly just happened at an Air Force base in rural England, why it spooked American military officials into emergency action,
sentences.zh: 英国乡村一个空军基地究竟发生了什么神秘事件？为什么它会让美国军方官员感到惊恐并采取紧急行动？

sentences.en: and what it may reveal about Iran's ambition to attack the United States much closer to home.
sentences.zh: 以及它可能揭示了伊朗在更近的地方袭击美国的野心。

sentences.en: My colleague, Pentagon reporter Eric Schmidt, tells us what he's learned.
sentences.zh: 我的同事、五角大楼记者埃里克·施密特将告诉我们他所了解的情况。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, October 7th.
sentences.zh: 今天是10月7日，星期三。

sentences.en: Eric, welcome back to the show.
sentences.zh: 埃里克，欢迎回到节目。

sentences.en: Always a pleasure to have you.
sentences.zh: 很高兴你能来。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: So you have been investigating what's been unfolding in and around an air base in rural England that has somehow gotten our entire national security apparatus on high alert.
sentences.zh: 你一直在调查英国乡村一个空军基地及其周边发生的事情，这些事情不知何故让我们的整个国家安全机构处于高度戒备状态。

sentences.en: So where does that story start?
sentences.zh: 那么这个故事是从哪里开始的呢？

sentences.en: Well, the story starts, Michael, in this bucolic village of Fairford, which is in southern England, as you said.
sentences.zh: 嗯，迈克尔，故事开始于你所说的英国南部那个田园诗般的费尔福德村。

sentences.en: It's in the Cotswolds.
sentences.zh: 它位于科茨沃尔德地区。

sentences.en: It's about a two-hour drive or so west of London.
sentences.zh: 距离伦敦大约两小时车程。

sentences.en: It's got a 15th-century church.
sentences.zh: 那里有一座15世纪的教堂。

sentences.en: It's got cattle and farms around.
sentences.zh: 周围有牛群和农场。

sentences.en: It's also right next to this decades-old British air base.
sentences.zh: 它旁边就是一个有几十年历史的英国空军基地。

sentences.en: Shortly after midnight on September 27th, a farmer, a woman, comes home after a party and discovers there are three white vans parked in front of her home.
sentences.zh: 9月27日午夜刚过，一位女农场主参加完派对回家，发现自家门前停着三辆白色货车。

sentences.en: And she realizes that there are men running away, masked men running away from these vans.
sentences.zh: 她意识到有男人正从这些货车里跑出来，而且是蒙面的。

sentences.en: So she does, I guess, as any, you know, good British woman would do, she calls the emergency services and said, something's going on around here.
sentences.zh: 于是她做了我想任何一个优秀的英国女性都会做的事：她拨打了紧急服务电话，说这里出事了。

sentences.en: And within minutes, the police are descending on this woman's home.
sentences.zh: 几分钟之内，警察就赶到了这位女士的家。

sentences.en: There are officers there.
sentences.zh: 警察在那里。

sentences.en: There are helicopters roaring overhead.
sentences.zh: 直升机在头顶轰鸣。

sentences.en: There's the bomb squad that showed up with a robot that's going to go through the vans.
sentences.zh: 拆弹小组带着机器人赶到，准备检查这些货车。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Looking for explosives and weapons.
sentences.zh: 搜寻爆炸物和武器。

sentences.en: And they round up and arrest these five guys who end up on the side of the street with a grainy photograph showing their shirts off,
sentences.zh: 他们围捕并逮捕了这五个人，这些人最后站在街边，照片拍得很模糊，他们光着上身，

sentences.en: standing there seeming like they're the culprits.
sentences.zh: 站在那里看起来像是罪魁祸首。

sentences.en: I mean, this seems on its face to be a rather big and maybe disproportionate response to a trio of vans in rural England.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，表面上看，对于英国乡村的三辆货车来说，这似乎是一个相当大、甚至可能不成比例的反应。

sentences.en: That's what I was thinking as I was actually on vacation out at the beach when I'm seeing all this reporting come in.
sentences.zh: 我当时在海边度假，看到所有这些报道涌入时，我也是这么想的。

sentences.en: So I start calling around to some of my military national security sources to see if they've heard anything, if they know what's going on.
sentences.zh: 所以我开始联系我的一些军事和国家安全消息来源，看看他们是否听到了什么，是否知道发生了什么。

sentences.en: And what I learned is that this is very serious because this isn't just any air base.
sentences.zh: 我了解到情况非常严重，因为这不仅仅是任何一个空军基地。

sentences.en: The Fairford base is one that American bombers have used for decades and have been using most recently in the Iran war to drop major bombs on targets inside of Iran.
sentences.zh: 费尔福德基地是美国轰炸机几十年来一直使用的基地，最近在伊朗战争中，他们一直用它来向伊朗境内的目标投掷重型炸弹。

sentences.en: And the concern I'm hearing from my sources is that this response, could it be some form of retaliation by Iran using proxies inside of England
sentences.zh: 我从消息来源那里听到的担忧是，这种反应会不会是伊朗利用英国境内的代理人进行的某种报复，

sentences.en: to have an attack on American troops and aircraft at a British base?
sentences.zh: 目的是袭击英国基地上的美军部队和飞机？

sentences.en: And it's like, holy cow, you know, because I've been covering this war now for, you know, we're in the eighth month and we've seen lots of attacks
sentences.zh: 这简直让人震惊，因为这场战争我已经报道了八个月了，我们看到了很多袭击，

sentences.en: in the Gulf region itself in the Middle EaSt.
sentences.zh: 发生在海湾地区，也就是中东。

sentences.en: But for something to be tied to American military personnel in England, this staunch ally a couple thousand miles away from Iran, this was quite dramatic.
sentences.zh: 但如果这件事与英国的美军人员有关，这个距离伊朗几千英里的坚定盟友，这就非常戏剧性了。

sentences.en: Well, what exactly are your sources telling you is the nature of their fear?
sentences.zh: 那么，你的消息来源究竟告诉你他们恐惧的本质是什么？

sentences.en: What do they know in the background?
sentences.zh: 他们背景里知道些什么？

sentences.en: And how does it relate to the men in masks who were found in this van?
sentences.zh: 这与在货车里发现的蒙面人有什么关系？

sentences.en: What are you starting to try to put together here?
sentences.zh: 你开始试图拼凑出什么？

sentences.en: So they take me back to July when Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps, which basically controls the security services in that country, threatened to go after bases in England,
sentences.zh: 他们把我带回了7月，当时伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队（基本上控制了该国的安全部门）威胁要袭击英国的基地，

sentences.en: basically because they're saying that England is helping participate in the war against Iran.
sentences.zh: 基本上是因为他们声称英国正在参与针对伊朗的战争。

sentences.en: But these threats were very general.
sentences.zh: 但这些威胁非常笼统。

sentences.en: They were not specific about time or exactly where in the base they might hit.
sentences.zh: 他们没有说明具体时间，也没有说明基地内具体袭击哪里。

sentences.en: But what these sources of mine were telling me was that two weeks or so before these vans showed up,
sentences.zh: 但我的这些消息来源告诉我，在这些货车出现前两周左右，

sentences.en: American officials, along with some of their British counterparts, got new information that was much more specific about the threat to the base itself
sentences.zh: 美国官员和一些英国同行获得了关于基地本身威胁的新情报，这些情报要具体得多，

sentences.en: and who perhaps could be behind it.
sentences.zh: 以及谁可能是幕后黑手。

sentences.en: And suddenly, this created a much greater sense of urgency that an attack might be imminent.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，这产生了一种更强烈的紧迫感，认为袭击可能迫在眉睫。

sentences.en: Around this same time,
sentences.zh: 大约在同一时间，

sentences.en: British officials in the town had been warning people to be aware of anything that looks suspicious.
sentences.zh: 镇上的英国官员一直在警告人们注意任何看起来可疑的事情。

sentences.en: And so there was this sense that something was going on in this town even before this incident with the vans took place.
sentences.zh: 所以即使在货车事件发生之前，镇上就有一种事情正在发生的感觉。

sentences.en: So there was a general message if you see something, say something.
sentences.zh: 所以有一个普遍的信息：如果你看到什么，就说出来。

sentences.en: And this woman, returning to her farm, very much saw something, very much said something.
sentences.zh: 而这位回到农场的女士，确实看到了什么，也确实说了出来。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And so that leads us to the 27th where the police show up.
sentences.zh: 这把我们带到了27日，警察赶到现场。

sentences.en: Obviously, with all these helicopters, the bomb squad, they've lined these guys up and they comb through these vans.
sentences.zh: 显然，带着所有这些直升机和拆弹小组，他们把这些人排成一排，仔细搜查了这些货车。

sentences.en: But they really don't find anything.
sentences.zh: 但他们真的什么也没发现。

sentences.en: It's just some jugs of gasoline.
sentences.zh: 只有几桶汽油。

sentences.en: There's no explosives.
sentences.zh: 没有爆炸物。

sentences.en: There's no weapons or anything.
sentences.zh: 没有武器或任何东西。

sentences.en: And suddenly, everybody's like, well, what was this all about?
sentences.zh: 突然间，每个人都在问，这到底是怎么回事？

sentences.en: Kind of like what Iranian plot?
sentences.zh: 就像是什么伊朗阴谋？

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: What Iranian plot?
sentences.zh: 什么伊朗阴谋？

sentences.en: And so the next day, the police release these five men on bail.
sentences.zh: 第二天，警方释放了这五名男子，准予保释。

sentences.en: And basically, it raised the question, well, was this a big nothing burger?
sentences.zh: 这基本上提出了一个问题：这难道是一场闹剧吗？

sentences.en: Or is it also suggesting that the evidence that they do have about this plot, not what they got from the vans, but surrounding the plot, is so classified,
sentences.zh: 还是说，他们掌握的关于这个阴谋的证据（不是从货车里得到的，而是围绕阴谋的）是如此机密，

sentences.en: they can't use it in a simple criminal case.
sentences.zh: 以至于他们不能在简单的刑事案件中使用？

sentences.en: Ah, fascinating.
sentences.zh: 啊，太迷人了。

sentences.en: So I go back to my sources and say, well, what happened here?
sentences.zh: 所以我回到我的消息来源那里问，这里发生了什么？

sentences.en: They just let these guys go.
sentences.zh: 他们就这样放走了这些人。

sentences.en: And what did your sources say?
sentences.zh: 你的消息来源是怎么说的？

sentences.en: Well, one of my sources say, well, don't get too hung up on that.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我的一位消息来源说，别太纠结于此。

sentences.en: This was probably just a diversion.
sentences.zh: 这可能只是一个转移注意力的手段。

sentences.en: These guys were chumps, in the words of one of my officials.
sentences.zh: 用我一位官员的话说，这些人只是笨蛋。

sentences.en: They were just basically a distraction for what might have happened somewhere else on the base.
sentences.zh: 他们基本上只是为了掩盖基地其他地方可能发生的事情。

sentences.en: That's one theory.
sentences.zh: 这是一种理论。

sentences.en: Another theory is that they were on their way to link up with Confederates who did have weapons, who did have explosives, and were intercepted before that could happen.
sentences.zh: 另一种理论是，他们正准备与拥有武器和爆炸物的同伙会合，但在那之前就被拦截了。

sentences.en: And as if this whole situation isn't mysterious enough, we get new information at the end of last week that one of the five men from the vans who was arrested
sentences.zh: 而且，如果整个情况还不够神秘的话，我们在上周末得到了新消息，货车里被捕的五人之一，

sentences.en: actually called the police before the police arrived.
sentences.zh: 实际上在警察到达之前就报了警。

sentences.en: Wait, he called the police on himself?
sentences.zh: 等等，他自己报警抓自己？

sentences.en: Apparently.
sentences.zh: 显然是这样。

sentences.en: And again, this is something we're still trying to sort out.
sentences.zh: 同样，这也是我们仍在努力理清的事情。

sentences.en: Was this somebody who was deliberately calling the cops to get everybody pulled over in one direction so that the other plotters might, you know, attack the base from another?
sentences.zh: 他是故意报警让所有人往一个方向赶，以便其他策划者可以从另一个方向袭击基地吗？

sentences.en: Or was this a guy who thought he, you know, was just out for some kind of criminal job or something like that?
sentences.zh: 还是说他只是以为自己要去做某种犯罪勾当之类的？

sentences.en: Maybe he was going to steal gas and realized he got in way over his head and he wants out.
sentences.zh: 也许他本来要去偷汽油，结果发现自己陷入了无法掌控的境地，想要退出。

sentences.en: And he calls to say, help.
sentences.zh: 于是他打电话求救。

sentences.en: Huh.
sentences.zh: 呵。

sentences.en: But one possibility that it sounds like you contemplate is perhaps this guy
sentences.zh: 但你似乎考虑过的一种可能性是，也许这个人

sentences.en: is part of a group hired by Iranians.
sentences.zh: 是伊朗人雇佣的团伙的一部分。

sentences.en: I know I'm in the realm of speculation.
sentences.zh: 我知道我是在进行推测。

sentences.en: And at some point, he realizes he's part of something that he doesn't want to be a part of.
sentences.zh: 在某个时刻，他意识到自己参与了一件他不想参与的事情。

sentences.en: And he's like, get me the heck out of here.
sentences.zh: 于是他想，赶紧让我离开这里。

sentences.en: I'm calling basically the British equivalent of 9-1-1 to shut this down.
sentences.zh: 我基本上是拨打了英国版的911来结束这一切。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And then we're really left with like, well, wait a minute.
sentences.zh: 然后我们真的会想，等等。

sentences.en: If this was such a serious plot, why are the plotters calling in ahead of time and giving up?
sentences.zh: 如果这是一个如此严重的阴谋，为什么策划者会提前报警并自首？

sentences.en: It doesn't make sense.
sentences.zh: 这说不通。

sentences.en: But then the plot kind of thickens.
sentences.zh: 但随后情节变得更加复杂。

sentences.en: There was a sixth man who was arrested.
sentences.zh: 还有第六个人被捕了。

sentences.en: And he was a British-Iranian citizen.
sentences.zh: 他是一名英籍伊朗裔公民。

sentences.en: So now, just as we thought, well, maybe this wasn't something, despite what my sources continue to tell me was quite serious.
sentences.zh: 所以现在，正如我们所想的，也许这没什么，尽管我的消息来源一直告诉我这非常严重。

sentences.en: Now, here's another instance where at least the police are saying, you know, there's cause enough to arrest this person.
sentences.zh: 现在，又出现了一个例子，至少警方说，有足够的理由逮捕这个人。

sentences.en: He too was released on bail, however.
sentences.zh: 不过，他也获准保释了。

sentences.en: And so we have suspects piling up, but there's no clear understanding of kind of where this is going.
sentences.zh: 所以嫌疑人越来越多，但对于事情的发展方向却没有明确的了解。

sentences.en: But then late last week,
sentences.zh: 但就在上周末晚些时候，

sentences.en: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham says that there are strong indications that Iran played a part.
sentences.zh: 英国首相安迪·伯纳姆表示，有强烈迹象表明伊朗参与其中。

sentences.en: But the question is, a part of what?
sentences.zh: 但问题是，参与了什么？

sentences.en: We still don't know, you know, what is this?
sentences.zh: 我们仍然不知道，这到底是什么？

sentences.en: Because he's not explaining what's going on.
sentences.zh: 因为他没有解释发生了什么。

sentences.en: The police aren't explaining.
sentences.zh: 警方也没有解释。

sentences.en: And my sources are being very cagey.
sentences.zh: 我的消息来源也非常谨慎。

sentences.en: They're saying, this is still live.
sentences.zh: 他们说，这仍然是进行中的事件。

sentences.en: There's still danger out there.
sentences.zh: 外面仍然有危险。

sentences.en: Uh-huh.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: So what you have on your hands at this point is a genuinely confounding and yet urgent mystery
sentences.zh: 所以你现在手里掌握的是一个真正令人困惑但又紧迫的谜团，

sentences.en: surrounding Iran and a British base that has some of America's most expensive and high-powered military planes.
sentences.zh: 围绕着伊朗和一个拥有美国最昂贵、最高性能军用飞机的英国基地。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And my sources are still telling me, don't give up on this.
sentences.zh: 我的消息来源仍然告诉我，不要放弃这个线索。

sentences.en: Even though these guys look like mopes on the ground and you can't make sense of what's happening here, there's something quite sinister behind all this
sentences.zh: 尽管这些人看起来像地上的蠢货，你无法理解这里发生了什么，但这一切背后有一些非常险恶的东西，

sentences.en: and you've got to stay on it because the authorities are on it as well.
sentences.zh: 你必须紧盯不放，因为当局也在紧盯不放。

sentences.en: And then on Sunday, the United States military does something so unusual, so extraordinary, it underscores how serious they consider this threat still to be.
sentences.zh: 然后在周日，美国军方做了一件非常不寻常、非常非凡的事情，这凸显了他们认为这种威胁仍然有多么严重。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Winnalou.
sentences.zh: 我是Winnalou。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games, and I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我编写了《纽约时报》游戏中的拼图游戏之一《Connections》，我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog, and I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗，也喜欢试图捉弄你。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Azersky, and I create the game spelling bee and letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·阿泽斯基，我每天负责创作《Spelling Bee》和《Letter Boxed》游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做联觉的东西。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像你刚才听到的这些人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 前往 nytimes.com/games 开始游戏吧。
